info.title: CircuLink API
info.description: The API behind the CircuLink resident app and the hub portal. All paths are under /api. Dates are Philippine time (UTC+8). Generated from server/scripts/api-catalog.js by npm run docs:api.

tags.name: reference
tags.description: Hubs, categories, rule numbers, photos and notifications

tags.name: dropoffs
tags.description: Residents declare items and get a drop-off code

tags.name: staff
tags.description: Hub staff check codes in, then weigh and sort items (the only place points are created)

tags.name: partners
tags.description: Approved partner organizations ask for reusable stock and confirm pickups

tags.name: stock
tags.description: Hub staff hand stock to partners, move items after sorting, and send recycle batches (items become final here)

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Admins: accounts, partner approval, hubs, recyclers, categories, flags and the audit log

get.summary: Is the API up, and can it reach the database?
get.description: No login needed. Error codes: 503 when the database is down.

get.summary: The privacy notice in English or Filipino

post.summary: Create a resident account (one per email, phone and student ID; privacy notice must be accepted)
post.description: No login needed. Error codes: bad_name, bad_email, bad_password, bad_phone, bad_student_id, privacy_required, signup_failed, too_many_requests.

post.summary: Log in; returns a token and the user
post.description: No login needed. Error codes: 401 bad_login, suspended, 429 too_many_attempts, too_many_requests.

get.summary: The logged-in account (with a renewed token once a day for residents)

post.description: Any logged-in account.

post.summary: Change the password (other sessions end; a new token is returned)
post.description: Any logged-in account. Error codes: wrong_password, bad_password.

post.summary: Agree to the current privacy notice
post.description: Any logged-in account.

post.description: Any logged-in account. Error codes: no_file, bad_file_type, file_too_large.

post.summary: Check a drop-off in by its code (works once, only at its hub, never your own)

get.summary: A drop-off at my hub, with the resident name

post.summary: Add an item the resident brought but did not list

post.description: Hub staff or admin. Error codes: bad_weight, bad_outcome, bad_state, bad_category, food_outcome, food_expiring, not_received, not_your_hub, own_drop_off, bad_photo.

get.summary: Flagged drop-offs (open, cleared or upheld)

post.description: Admins only. Error codes: bad_decision, bad_state, not_found, own_drop_off.

post.description: Hub staff or admin. Error codes: not_found, bad_state, recycler_not_accredited, not_your_hub.
